[Section] Level A: Offensive language Detection
[source_id=19] Level A discriminates between offensive (OFF) and non-offensive (NOT) tweets.
[source_id=20] Not Offensive (NOT): Posts that do not contain offense or profanity;
[source_id=21] Offensive (OFF): We label a post as offensive if it contains any form of non-acceptable language (profanity) or a targeted offense, which can be veiled or direct. This category includes insults, threats, and posts containing profane language or swear words.
